description: This file provides React components for integrating Clerk authentication into a React app, including environment variable handling, route guards, sign-in/sign-up pages, and user controls.

methods.name: getClerkPublishableKey
methods.description: Retrieves the Clerk publishable key from environment variables, providing a warning if missing.

methods.name: AppAuthProvider
methods.description: Wraps children components with ClerkProvider if a valid publishable key is available; otherwise, displays a warning banner.

methods.name: ProtectedRoute
methods.description: A route guard component that renders children if user is signed in, otherwise shows sign-in prompt.

methods.name: SignInPage
methods.description: Component rendering the Clerk sign-in interface with custom theming.

methods.name: SignUpPage
methods.description: Component rendering the Clerk sign-up interface with custom theming.

methods.name: AuthControls
methods.description: Displays either a sign-in link or user account button based on Clerk authentication state.
